purpose: Select the production neural representation on an exactly paired state/target corpus without changing game rules, traversal utility, action abstraction, accepted R7.3/R7.4 behavior semantics, or strategic acceptance gates.

nonwinning_diagnostics.reason: structural control only; fails suit-permutation invariance
interpretability diagnostic only; precommitted as ineligible as sole primary flop abstraction

accepted_behavior_contract.scenario_cycles: exact R7.4 HU and THREE_HANDED scenario cycles

paired_corpus.coverage_extension_rule: Extend by exactly 64 roots only when a required paired-sample minimum is not met; never extend because a candidate performed poorly.
sample_pair: SPNNIV2 bytes from the identical state
objective V2 semantic tags for diagnostics
paired_corpus.v2_serialization_rng_effect: FORBIDDEN; serialization must consume no RNG
paired_corpus.behavior_observation: SPNNIV1 only, preserving the accepted R7.3/R7.4 behavior path while the corpus is collected
paired_corpus.retention_if_over_cap: Keep the lexicographically smallest SHA256 retention keys computed from the immutable paired sample. Retention consumes no traversal RNG.
paired_corpus.merge: After per-seed collection, merge both corpus seeds within each domain before candidate fitting.

heldout_split.method: SHA256(split_seed || immutable paired-sample identity); first 80 percent of hash space is train, remainder heldout

candidate_fit.note: Unused V2 flop embedding rows remain allocated so H4 receives no parameter-count advantage over H1/H2/H3/NONE.

unchanged_absolute_gates.scope: Every eligible candidate must pass every gate in both domains. Advantage/policy gates apply to each fit seed; cross-fit gates apply on identical heldout observations.

semantic_sentinel_subsets.source: objective SPNNIV2 tags only; never legacy action recommendations
families: flush draw / OESD / gutshot / double-gutshot / backdoors
semantic_sentinel_subsets.below_minimum: report only; cannot move the selection score

selection_order.rule: Discard every candidate that fails any unchanged absolute gate. If none survives, R7.5.3 is BLOCKED; gates may not be relaxed.

selection_order.metric: worst-domain mean heldout advantage weighted NRMSE across the three fit seeds
worst-domain mean heldout AveragePolicy TV to paired strategy target
worst-domain macro mean advantage NRMSE across eligible semantic sentinel subsets
measured CPU inference time on the same heldout batch
active flop tokens for V2 candidates

selection_order.rule: If still tied, retain C0_V1_FROZEN_CONTROL rather than claiming an unproven production representation change.

required_report: paired corpus hashes and counts by domain/kind/seed/street/tag
heldout advantage NRMSE per domain/candidate/fit seed
heldout policy TV per domain/candidate/fit seed
deterministic selection trace applying the frozen order
action_abstraction_during_r7_5_3: FROZEN CURRENT SIX-SLOT CONTROL; no action-set comparison is allowed until R7.5.4
